summary_en: This Phase 1/1b study tests recombinant Erwinia asparaginase and venetoclax given together with blinatumomab in adults with relapsed or refractory CD19-positive B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia. Asparaginase Erwinia is given by injection into the muscle on days 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 and 13; venetoclax is taken by mouth daily on days 1 to 14 or every other day on those odd-numbered days; and blinatumomab is given as a continuous IV infusion on days 8 to 35 of cycle 1 and days 1 to 28 of cycle 2, for up to 2 cycles. The record does not state a primary outcome; it says the study looks at safety, side effects, and how well the combination works.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/1b evalúa la asparaginasa Erwinia recombinante y venetoclax, administrados junto con blinatumomab, en adultos con leucemia linfoblástica aguda de células B positiva para CD19 que recidivó o es refractaria. La asparaginasa Erwinia se aplica por inyección intramuscular los días 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 y 13; el venetoclax se toma por vía oral a diario los días 1 a 14, o cada dos días en los días impares indicados; y el blinatumomab se administra como infusión intravenosa continua los días 8 a 35 del ciclo 1 y los días 1 a 28 del ciclo 2, hasta 2 ciclos. El registro no indica un resultado principal; dice que el estudio evalúa la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y qué tan bien funciona la combinación.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory CD19-positive B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
At least 5% blasts in the bone marrow
ECOG 2 or lower, or Karnofsky score 70 or higher
Heart pumping function (LVEF) of 50% or higher, with other lab values within stated limits
not_for: Allogeneic stem cell transplant within 8 weeks before starting study treatment
Active leukemia in the central nervous system
History of grade 3 or higher pancreatitis, or known allergy to study drugs
Other active cancer, with listed exceptions
